title: POL Terminals
research_status: no_public_maintained_source; DHS crosswalk row resolved: layer migrated to secure GII; open endpoints verified dead 2026-11-13; successor-product and access-grant decisions recorded in handoff
summary: POL Terminals is an ORNL/Argonne (+NGA HSIP) curated compilation (crude oil and refined products, per-row SOURCE curation, TERM_ID identity; last public update 2,302 terminals, data period ending 2024-10-11). DHS's August 2025 HIFLD Open crosswalk row (retrieved and inspected 2026-11-13) marks the layer 'Migrated' to the 'GII Portal' with 'GII Access Required: Yes' and agency 'Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL)'; its listed Open REST Service and Open item were both verified dead on 2026-11-13. No ORNL/DOE public endpoint publishes the compilation. The only public copy is the DataLumos rescue archive (never a pipeline input). Maintained but materially different successor products exist (EIA-815 petroleum product terminals on EIA's own ArcGIS org; ORNL IFAC mirrors the EIA-based CSV). Choosing a successor, requesting a GII access grant, or parking/retiring the dataset requires a maintainer decision.

source_candidates.name: DataLumos rescue archive of HIFLD OPEN POL Terminals
source_candidates.lineage: Citation names DOE Office of Science / ORNL and DHS as authors, ICPSR as distributor (2025-11-07). Final HIFLD Open snapshot: geodatabase/geojson/geopackage/shapefile plus metadata.xml; content describes 2,302 terminals with revalidation of 658 records, +10/-47; time period 2021-11-08 through 2024-10-11.
source_candidates.observed_access: Project pages render via remote reader (2026-11-13) but direct fetches are Cloudflare-challenged (HTTP 403) from this environment. Regardless, DataLumos is a rescue archive and is never a pipeline input or refresh source.

source_candidates.name: EIA Petroleum Product Terminal (Form EIA-815) on EIA's ArcGIS org
source_candidates.observed_access: 2026-11-13: layer metadata HTTP 200 from this environment; 10 fields (OBJECTID, Company, Site, City, State, PADD, Source, Period, Longitude, Latitude); data last edit 2023-06-27 observed on this endpoint, so refresh cadence must be verified before any use.
source_candidates.lineage: Product terminals only (EIA-815 monthly bulk terminal and blender report); no crude-oil-only terminals, no TERM_ID/per-row SOURCE curation; different schema and coverage from the ORNL/Argonne compilation.
source_candidates.decision: Materially different source product; substitution for the ORNL compilation requires an explicit maintainer decision, not silent adoption.

source_candidates.name: ORNL IFAC portal (EIA-based Petroleum Product Terminals CSV)
source_candidates.observed_access: ORNL's official IFAC catalog lists an EIA-815-based 'Petroleum Product Terminals' CSV; it is not the ORNL/Argonne POL crude+products compilation.
source_candidates.decision: Materially different product; maintainer decision required before any use.
